scripts.build:staff: vite build --config vite.config.staff.ts && node scripts/postbuild-rename-html.cjs staff
scripts.build:client: vite build --config vite.config.client.ts && node scripts/postbuild-rename-html.cjs client
scripts.build:driver: vite build --config vite.config.driver.ts && node scripts/postbuild-rename-html.cjs driver
scripts.build:all: pnpm build:staff && pnpm build:client && pnpm build:driver
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist dist-staff dist-client dist-driver server.js
scripts.cap:sync:staff: pnpm build:staff && node scripts/with-cap-config.cjs staff npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:client: pnpm build:client && node scripts/with-cap-config.cjs client npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:driver: pnpm build:driver && node scripts/with-cap-config.cjs driver npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android:run: pnpm cap:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.cap:add:staff: node scripts/with-cap-config.cjs staff npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:client: node scripts/with-cap-config.cjs client npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:driver: node scripts/with-cap-config.cjs driver npx cap add android
scripts.apk:all:debug: pnpm apk:staff:debug && pnpm apk:client:debug && pnpm apk:driver:debug
